asr.full_text: Welcome to Mirror Trading International's official investor presentation. Mirror Trading International, PTY Ltd., is a registered company in the Republic of South Africa. The registered office is situated at 43 Plain Street in Stellenbosch, in the Western Cape of South Africa. Johan Steynberg, from Polokuani in South Africa, is the CEO and founder. The attorneys and legal advisors of Mirror Trading International, is the ceo and founder. The attorneys and legal advisors of Mirra Trading International are Alwich Rue and associates who have their offices in Parkhurst, Johannesburg. The objective of Mirra Trading International is to grow your bitcoin. Your balance in trade is always in bitcoin and you earn bitcoin daily. This means the number of bitcoin in your trading pool will increase day by day. This also means that when the price of bitcoin rises, so too will the value of your trading account increase. MTI has a sustainable business model trading Forex Monday to Friday using advanced artificial intelligence software, with Bitcoin as its base currency. The profitability of Miratrading International comes solely from the trading activities. Your full Bitcoin investment goes into your trading account. MTI provides you with a passive income opportunity. Earn passively from daily trading activities. Remember, trade results are not guaranteed, but no trading knowledge is required. In MTI there are no admin fees, no membership fees, no subscriptions, no packages, no costs and no deductions. Properties from successful daily trades are divided and allocated as follows 40% goes to you the member 20 percent to the binary bonus pool 5 percent to the p1 & p2 leadership bonus pool and 25 percent to the traders 10 percent to MTI for administration and to pay the referral bonuses please remember that historical results on no guarantee of future results all income is subject to positive daily trading results. The system is fully automated, and you can sit back and relax and receive your daily statement detailing the income from the trades for the day. These statements will be in your back office from Tuesdays to Saturdays. Your daily trade profits are automatically compounded. Withdrawals In MTI there are no contracts and no lockdowns. You can withdraw in full or partial amounts and you can withdraw whenever you like. There are no withdrawal fees or penalties. Your requested amount will be sent to your bitcoin wallet within 48 hours. Providing you with a passive sustainable income from your bitcoin in trade is at the very heart of Mirror Trading International. To start you will need to register with MTI and fund your account with bitcoin. The suggested minimum is $100 worth of bitcoin. Accounts not funded within seven days will be deleted however you may register again. That summarizes the passive part of the opportunity and as a member you will earn from the trading activities and grow your bitcoin. Mirror Trading International has an optional referral program should you wish to refer your friends or new members. For more information please contact the person who sent you this presentation.

textual.observation: The presentation promises that a member can grow bitcoin and earn bitcoin daily through passive trading, while requesting registration and bitcoin funding with a suggested minimum of $100.

evidence.quote: The objective of Mirra Trading International is to grow your bitcoin. Your balance in trade is always in bitcoin and you earn bitcoin daily.
To start you will need to register with MTI and fund your account with bitcoin. The suggested minimum is $100 worth of bitcoin.

textual.context: Presented as an investor presentation and described as a passive income opportunity; the source also states that trade results are not guaranteed.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised bitcoin growth and daily passive income are directly linked to registering and funding an account with bitcoin, which may require later assessment of the offer, conditions and outcome claims.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether the trading activities occurred, whether the claimed returns were achieved, or whether any funds were lost.

textual.observation: The presentation states that requested withdrawals will be sent to a bitcoin wallet within 48 hours and says withdrawals can be full or partial without fees or penalties.

evidence.quote: You can withdraw in full or partial amounts and you can withdraw whenever you like.
There are no withdrawal fees or penalties. Your requested amount will be sent to your bitcoin wallet within 48 hours.

textual.context: This is a stated withdrawal condition in the presentation; the records do not show an actual withdrawal request or result.
textual.potential_relevance: The specific timing and fee-free withdrawal claim is connected to the handling and return of bitcoin deposited into the account and may require later assessment of whether the stated condition was met.
textual.limitations: The source does not establish whether withdrawals were processed, whether the 48-hour timeframe applied in practice, or whether additional conditions existed.

textual.observation: The presentation describes an optional referral program in which members may refer friends or new members, and states that 10% is allocated to MTI for administration and referral bonuses.

evidence.quote: 25 percent to the traders 10 percent to MTI for administration and to pay the referral bonuses
Mirror Trading International has an optional referral program should you wish to refer your friends or new members.

textual.context: The referral program is explicitly described as optional and is presented as part of the company's member opportunity.
textual.potential_relevance: A potential referral benefit is linked to recruiting friends or new members, creating a recruitment-related reward structure for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not specify the exact referral payout, eligibility requirements, or whether any referred members joined or generated payments.

visual.observation: The presentation promotes growing Bitcoin through daily forex trading with Bitcoin as the base currency and states that a member's full Bitcoin investment goes into a trading account.
visual.context: Visible investor-presentation slides presenting the trading and investment model; promotional versus informational intent is not independently verifiable from the sampled frames.
visual.potential_relevance: A promised trading-based return is directly linked to transferring or placing Bitcoin into a stated trading account, which is a task-relevant investment and asset-flow relationship.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show an actual account, transfer, recipient wallet, transaction, or resulting return.

visual.observation: Slides state that daily trading income is allocated to members at 40% and show a total daily trading income figure of 1.5108%, while also stating that the income is historical and not guaranteed for future results.
visual.context: The slide visibly includes the qualification: "Historical results are no guarantee of future results."
visual.potential_relevance: A specific recurring return allocation and daily percentage are presented in connection with the investment program, making the stated return claim conditionally relevant for review.
visual.limitations: The sampled frame does not establish whether the displayed figures are accurate, typical, available to all members, or achievable in practice.

visual.observation: The presentation states that investors can withdraw in full or in part whenever they want, with no withdrawal fees or penalties, and that requests are paid within 48 hours.
visual.context: These are visible withdrawal terms in an investor-presentation slide.
visual.potential_relevance: A promised rapid and fee-free return of invested Bitcoin is linked to participation in the trading program and to a stated withdrawal process.
visual.limitations: No withdrawal request, payment, account balance, or completed payout is visible, and the frames do not establish whether the stated terms are enforceable.

visual.observation: The presentation describes the offering as providing passive, sustainable income from Bitcoin in trade and separately instructs viewers to contact the person who sent the presentation for more information.
visual.context: The visible slides use promotional language about passive income and direct the viewer to contact the sender; the frames do not show the sender's identity or the contact method.
visual.potential_relevance: A promised passive-income benefit is linked to a requested contact step with the sender, creating a task-relevant benefit-and-contact relationship.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show what information would be requested, whether contact leads to enrollment or payment, or what happens afterward.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes a Bitcoin-funded trading opportunity that asks viewers to register and fund an account with at least $100 in exchange for potential daily income and Bitcoin growth. It claims fee-free withdrawals to a Bitcoin wallet within 48 hours and directs interested viewers to contact the sender, while also describing optional referral recruitment. The displayed figures are presented as historical and non-guaranteed, and no actual deposit, withdrawal, return, or loss is shown.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The presentation links Bitcoin capital participation to a managed trading account and emphasizes passive, daily and automatically compounded returns. The stated return source is Forex trading, while no paid guidance or mining package is evidenced.
